howTo.title: How to Use the Instagram Username Generator
lead: Every batch mixes three things: the word you type, the IG style you choose, and the options under Customize. Symbols are off by default because Instagram's username field rejects them; turn them on only for ideas you plan to use in the name field or bio.

Leave the word blank and the generator pairs two style words instead — velvetmoon, honeydiary, silentapex — so it also works as a random IG name generator for a second account, a brand or an anonymous page.
steps: Your first name, a nickname, a hobby, a brand. The generator keeps it whole and builds around it: sofia becomes sofia.haze, softsofia or sofiadiary.
Aesthetic, cute, cool, baddie, minimal, creator, vintage or dark. Each has its own vocabulary; All Styles mixes them so you can compare.
Use the IG-safe filter to hide anything with symbols, heart the ones you like, then copy and paste into Instagram's username field to check availability.

platforms.title: What Instagram Allows in a Username
platforms.intro: Instagram's username field is stricter than its name field. These shortcuts generate ideas that fit each situation.

cards.title: Instagram Username (handle)
cards.text: Up to 30 characters: letters, numbers, periods and underscores only. No spaces, no symbols, and a period cannot be the last character. This is the @name people search for.

cards.title: Instagram Name (display)
cards.text: Up to 64 characters and accepts spaces, emoji and Unicode symbols — this is where ♡, ⋆ and fancy letters belong. Generate with symbols on, then style it with a font tool.

cards.title: Second account / finsta
cards.text: Alts usually drop the real name entirely. Leave the word blank and pick dark, minimal or funny words — two-word results with no personal detail.

cards.title: Same handle on TikTok
cards.text: TikTok usernames follow nearly the same rules (letters, numbers, periods, underscores, 24 characters), so an IG-safe result usually works there too. Check both before you commit.

formulas.title: How to Make a Good Instagram Username
formulas.intro: The generator follows a handful of formulas. Knowing them helps you tweak a result — or build your own IG username by hand.
rows: **Sofia** + **Haze** → the most natural pairing; the word sets the mood
**Sofia** + **.** + **Haze** → the period is the single most useful IG trick; it frees a taken name without a number
**Soft** / **Frost** + **Sofia** → describes you before your name lands
**its** / **just** / **iam** + **Sofia** → reads like a caption, easy to remember
**Sofia** + **diary** → tells people what the page is
**Velvet** + **Moon** → no name at all, for a brand or an alt
**Sofia** → **sofiaa**, **soffia** → keeps the sound, changes the string
**Sofia** + **444** / birth year → a number with meaning looks intentional, 8371 looks like a fallback
formulas.note: One trick per handle. *sofia.haze* is a good Instagram username; *xo_sofiaa.haze444_* is not. If the plain version is taken, add a period first, a prefix second, and a number last. Never end a handle with a period — Instagram will reject it.

guide.title: How Our Instagram Username Generator Works
guide.intro: There is no AI behind this page and no connection to Instagram. IG usernames are assembled in your browser from five ingredients:
bullets: The name or word you type is cleaned to letters and numbers and kept whole in every result. Leave it blank and the generator picks a noun from the style instead.

Each of the eight styles has its own hand-written list — moon, haze and velvet for aesthetic; queen, luxe and icon for baddie; diary, lens and studio for creators — so a minimal result never borrows a baddie word by accident.

Name + word, adjective + name, prefix + name, name + period + word, two style words, doubled letters, and short numeric suffixes. Patterns rotate within a batch so you never get 24 versions of the same idea.
Symbols are off, so every result uses only letters, numbers, periods and underscores. The Mix separator setting adds a period or underscore to some results; pick Period to apply it to all of them.
The heart saves a name to your browser's localStorage. Nothing is sent to a server, and the generator cannot check whether a handle is free.
outro: To check availability, paste the handle into Instagram's Edit Profile → Username field: it shows a red warning immediately if the name is taken or contains a character it does not allow.

uniqueH2: Instagram Username vs Instagram Name — Which One to Generate?
uniqueBody: Instagram gives every profile two names. The **username** (the @handle) is what people type to find you: up to 30 characters, letters, numbers, periods and underscores only, unique across all of Instagram. The **name** is the bold line under your photo: up to 64 characters, spaces and emoji allowed, symbols allowed, and it does not have to be unique. Most "my username won't save" problems come from mixing the two up — trying to put ♡ or a space into the handle.

This Instagram username generator is built for the handle: symbols are off by default and the IG-safe filter hides anything Instagram would reject. For the name field, switch symbols on, or take a plain result and run it through the [Instagram font generator](/instagram-font-generator.html) for cursive, bold or aesthetic letters. A common combination is a plain handle like *sofia.haze* with a styled name like *𝓈𝑜𝒻𝒾𝒶 ⋆ 𝒽𝒶𝓏𝑒*.

One more Instagram-specific rule: you can change your username at any time, but Instagram holds your old handle for 14 days so you can switch back, and nobody else can claim it during that window. If you are renaming a brand account, keep the old one alive somewhere in your bio for a while so people can still find you. For other platforms, the main [username generator](/username-generator.html) covers TikTok, Discord, Roblox and gaming handles with their own rules.

faqs: What is an Instagram username generator?

It is a tool that combines a word you choose with curated vocabulary — aesthetic, cute, cool, baddie, minimal, creator, vintage or dark — and naming patterns to produce IG username ideas that follow Instagram's character rules. This one runs in your browser, is free, and lets you copy any result with one click.
What are some good Instagram username ideas?

Examples from the styles above: sofia.haze, softsofia, bunnypeach, frostsofia, sofia.luxe, just.sofia, sofiadaily and voidnoir. Type your own name to get versions built around it; leave it blank for two-word ideas with no personal detail.
Does this Instagram username generator check availability?

No. Nothing on this page talks to Instagram, so it cannot know whether a handle is taken. Copy the one you like and paste it into Edit Profile → Username on Instagram; it warns you immediately if the name is unavailable.
What characters can I use in an Instagram username?
Letters, numbers, periods and underscores, up to 30 characters, and the handle cannot end with a period. No spaces, no symbols, no emoji. Those are allowed in the separate name field and in your bio.
How do I make my Instagram username aesthetic?

Keep it lowercase, use one soft word (haze, moon, velvet, cloud) and at most one period. Pick the Aesthetic style above, or use the dedicated [aesthetic username generator](/aesthetic-username-generator.html) for sixteen sub-styles. Then style your name field with the [Instagram font generator](/instagram-font-generator.html).
Can I use an AI Instagram username generator instead?

You can, but AI name tools tend to invent unpronounceable strings and often ignore Instagram's character rules. This generator uses hand-written word lists and fixed patterns, so every result is readable and IG-safe by default — and nothing you type leaves your browser.
What should I do if my Instagram username is taken?

Add a period between the words (sofiahaze → sofia.haze), try a prefix (its, just, iam), swap the style word, or add a number that means something to you. Click Generate More for another batch; small changes usually free up a name.
Can I use the same username on TikTok?

Usually. TikTok allows letters, numbers, periods and underscores up to 24 characters, so an IG-safe handle under 24 characters works there too. Check both apps before you commit, and use the Short filter to stay under the limit.
